title: A content worker runs the landing's lint on every article its branch changes, not only the new one
goal: python3 .claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py --changed REF lints the articles changed from REF's merge base to the working tree, the list land passes, and exits 0 when none fails, and the worker role file's rule 4 has a content worker run lint.py --changed origin/main before each commit. SP-rsmmwzr2 close: ST-unrlktke's landing stopped at step lint on an article the worker had not linted.

run:
import subprocess as s,sys
p=s.run([sys.executable,'.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py','--changed','origin/main'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();r=t[t.find('4. **'):];rule='lint.py --changed origin/main' in r[:r.find('\n5. ')]
print('lint --changed exit',p.returncode,'| rule 4 names it',rule);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and rule else 1)
